burn.estimate: About {n} min. Writing cannot be undone, and stopping midway ruins the disc.
burn.rateIntro: Check the result: how accurate was this downloaded calibration? Your score helps others choose, and the form lets you attach the original and the result.
burn.rateNote: Clicking a star opens GitHub in your browser; nothing is published until you submit.
burn.shareIntro: This calibration has been burned for real. If you are happy with the result, share it with the community so others waste fewer discs. You can attach the original and the result.
burn.stopWarn: Stopping now ruins this disc. Are you sure?
burn.warnNoSpeed: No burn speed supported by this disc and drive was found.
drive.unsupported: Only DVD discs are supported for now; this one is {type}
burn.warnNotBlank: This disc is not blank and may not accept data.
burn.warnSim: Virtual drive: the burn is only simulated and nothing is written to any disc.
cal.autosave: The calibration is saved automatically when done.
cal.burnNote: Writes random calibration data. This disc is only for calibration afterwards.
cal.devNote: Dev simulation: blank disc → calibrate → share
cal.deleteBody: This calibration record will be deleted. Saved calibrations are not affected.
cal.forUnlisted: Calibrating a disc that is not listed.
cal.logFail: Could not save the calibration record: {e}
cal.measureNote: Reads the calibration disc to work out this disc's spiral geometry. Read-only; nothing is written.
cal.saved: Calibration saved. Burn a disc with it first, and share it once you are happy with the result.
cal.shareTip: Burn a disc with this calibration for real first; you can share once the result is confirmed
cal.step1: Insert a blank disc and burn the calibration disc
cal.step2: Insert the burned calibration disc and start measuring
cal.suspectErr: The measurement is unreliable and was not saved. Calibrate again.
cal.suspectMsg: This measurement is unreliable and was not saved.
cal.times: Burning takes about 15 min, measuring about {n} min.
cal.tip: Calibrating uses up a blank disc of the same model as the one you want to burn. Search the community first: someone may already have calibrated it.
cal.title: Calibrate a new disc
carve.title: New carving
carve.darkWarn: This image is dark and may spoil the disc.
carve.hint: Add images, drag to place, drag a corner to resize, drag the dot to rotate
carve.riskBody: This image is too dark. Burning it may spoil this disc. Continue anyway?
carve.riskDeclined: Stopped. Nothing was written to this disc.
carve.selfCheckFail: Something went wrong building the image. Stopped; nothing was written to this disc. Please report this (code {n}/{lba}).
carve.servoWarn: With protection off, thick black lines may spoil the disc.
drive.label: Drive
home.lede: Click a button below to get started.
menu.label: Menu
models.fallback: Disc not listed? Use up a disc to calibrate it
models.intro: Enter the code printed on the clear ring on the disc's inner edge, e.g. CMDR47G-CFMWMO3-0237 L110. Part of it is enough.
models.offlineNone: Cannot reach the library, so nothing was found. Check your network and try again, or calibrate locally.
models.offlineSome: Cannot reach the library; showing local records only.
models.title: Search the library
nav.label: Workspace
presets.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted for good. This calibration cannot be recovered.
presets.label: Disc calibration
presets.matched: Selected automatically from the disc in the drive.
presets.title: Choose a disc
process.terminatedBad: The burn was stopped. This disc cannot be used any more.
share.brand: Disc brand (optional, helps others find it)
share.code: The code on the disc's inner ring, e.g. CMDR47G-CFMWMO3-0237 L110
share.intro: This calibration has been verified with a real burn. Sharing it saves the next person with this disc a wasted disc and half an hour.
share.mockDone: Mock contribution recorded. Search MOCK-0001 on the Library page.
share.note: Sharing opens GitHub in your browser with everything filled in. You can drag the original image and a photo of the result into the form (optional); nothing is published until you submit. A GitHub account is required, and you appear under your GitHub username.
share.pledge: I promise this is real data that I calibrated myself and verified with a real burn, and that the code and brand are accurate. Fake or careless entries pollute the community library and make others waste discs.
share.title: Share calibration
update.latest: You are on the latest version
update.noNotes: This version has no release notes.
update.note: The app restarts when this finishes.
update.title: Update to {version}
carve.discardBody: This composition has not been saved. Continuing loses these changes.
